name: B10-0096/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Turkey to stop pressuring journalists and critics. It wants all political prisoners freed, including Osman Kavala and Selahattin Demirtaş. It says Turkey's courts are used for political ends and may not give journalist Bülent Mumay a fair result. It asks the European Union to condemn this pressure, watch journalists' trials, spend money on independent media and civil society in Turkey, and offer emergency visas to journalists and rights activists at risk.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Turkey's government, its courts, journalists and activists, and European Union institutions.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to Turkey's government and parliament and to European Union bodies.
